definitions.explanation: Very polite term for someone else's grandmother, or a respectful way to refer to an elderly woman. Also written お{祖母様|ばあさま}. More formal than おばあさん.

examples.japanese: おばあさま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
おばあさま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧{九十歳|きゅうじっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なられた→なる：01970_naru⟧そうです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I hear your grandmother turned ninety this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おばあさま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一番前|いちばんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: At the wedding, the bride's grandmother sat in the front row.

notes:
The honorific prefix お plus ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧. Used for the listener's or a third party's grandmother; for your own grandmother when talking to outsiders, say ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧.

REGISTER:
From casual to formal:
- ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧: grandma — casual, affectionate
- ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧: my grandmother — humble; for your own grandmother
- ⟦おばあさん→おばあさん：02863_obaasan⟧: grandmother; old woman — standard polite
- おばあさま: grandmother — very polite, usually someone else's

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おじいさま: grandfather (very polite) — the parallel form
- ⟦お{母様|かあさま}→お母様：31377_okaasama⟧: mother (very polite)
